value.value: UIR

For a new interface, the user speaks in product language. The agent compiles one confirmed decision at a time, the prototype makes visible and invisible meaning inspectable, and production code waits until the package is accepted and frozen.
THE SECOND PATH
01 — Describe the job, audience, real content, and named evidence.
02 — Compile each confirmed decision into the one UIR package.
03 — Correct the visual board and semantic inspector conversationally.
04 — Freeze only after every required gap is explicit and both sides are accepted.
Start from words, not a blank canvas.
User words, product sources, and assets explicitly supplied for this run.
01 · Named evidence
Visible facts, semantic facts, design system, provenance, and explicit gaps.
02 · One UIR package
A board and inspector that can be reproduced from the package alone.
03 · Live projection
Return to extraction
The interface is the source. Code is a derived artifact.
UIR
python3 tool/extract_react.py --root <repo> --app <app/src> --change-set .uir/reading.json
USER INTERFACE REPRESENTATION · PRIVATE ALPHA
UIR is one self-contained source for what an interface looks like, what it means, which design decisions realize it, and what remains unresolved.
Extract your interface
See the representation
Make the interface explicit before code gets the final word.
An agent compiles intent and named evidence into UIR. The live prototype derives a visual board and semantic inspector from the same package. Corrections go back to that one addressable fact.
ONE PACKAGE · TWO READABLE SIDES
See the drawing. Inspect the meaning. Approve both.
Build from zero
Extract
Why a standard
Executable, but the intent it lowered is usually absent.
The code
Fast to see, but semantics and implementation drift arrive later.
The design
THE PROBLEM
Design files show appearance. Code shows one implementation. Design systems show reusable decisions. None carries the complete visible and semantic interface as one authority.
Reusable values and Pieces, but not the whole interface or its unresolved meaning.
The system
Your UI has several clues. It still has no source.
# CI integration is alpha and remains an explicit adoption task
Put the same measurement at the pull request, where design conformance is already being judged.
3 · Adopt
The reader uses your own compiler and styling framework. It records what it could observe, refuses silent fallbacks, and separates decided work from unchecked silence.
THE SHORTEST PATH TO VALUE
python3 tool/extract_react.py --root <repo> --app <app/src> --design-system-source <system/src> --change-set .uir/reading.json
Point UIR at the app and the design-system sources you authorize for this run.
1 · Read
python3 tool/uir_report.py --change-set .uir/reading.json
Render the checklist, findings, and explicit remainder without turning silence into a pass.
2 · See
Start with the interface you already ship.

The contracts, checker, extractors, preview, and intake are designed to be open under Apache 2.0. The language stays vendor-neutral and framework-independent. Missing meaning is counted; it is never repaired with a convenient guess.
Declared, derived, and inferred decisions never collapse into one confidence-free answer.
Every claim has provenance
Missing, external, and waived work stays addressable and visible.
Silence is forbidden
BUILT TO EARN THE WORD STANDARD
The interface and its compiled design system travel together.
One source
Frameworks lower a frozen UIR; they do not redefine it.
Targets come later
Open where trust depends on it. Strict where comparability depends on it.

The Step 1 toolchain, checker, renderer, inspector, conformance measurement, and CI gates exist. UIR v0.1 is not frozen, the public distribution seam is not open, and production lowering remains later work.
Working now — deterministic package checking, extraction, live boards, semantic inspection, and measured findings.
Open now — contract gaps and deferred checks that still block the v0.1 freeze.
Not claimed — a finished public install, production target compiler, or broad adopter ecosystem.
CURRENT STATUS
Alpha, with the unfinished parts in view.
